common.footer: Sneplus Live - live commerce platform. Auctions and Buy-Now drops, server-verified in real time.

hero.title: E-commerce. But Live.
hero.description: Live Commerce is shopping and selling through live video, where customers can interact with the host, ask questions, and buy or bid directly during the live stream.

steps.title: Host goes live
steps.description: A host presents products on camera, viewers join and start chatting instantly.

steps.title: The bidding opens
steps.description: A starting price appears, the countdown runs, and bids climb in real time.

steps.title: Highest bid wins
steps.description: When the clock hits zero, the top bidder wins the drop and the next item comes up.
